sources.title: FinCEN CDD rule
sources.supported_claim: CDD includes identity, beneficial ownership, nature/purpose and risk-based ongoing monitoring.

sources.title: FinCEN FIN2026R001
sources.supported_claim: Relief permits beneficial-owner identification at first account opening, reliability-triggered or risk-based occasions rather than every account. Other AML/CFT obligations continue; institutional adoption must be confirmed.

sources.title: FFIEC CDD
sources.supported_claim: EDD may collect funds/wealth, business activity and expected volumes; ongoing diligence follows customer risk.
